events.title: Crane sets a module into the frame

participants.note: static site actor until donor hull promoted

environment: 1 module prop staged at the rack
events.arrangement: Rig over the frame; module rides the hoist line from rack to the next empty frame slot
events.startConditions: Site has delivered inventory (aftermath of ev_construction_delivery) and an empty slot
events.visibleCue: The crane traverses - on a hull that has held still all day, rotation IS the event

phases.name: pick
phases.visible: Hook drops to the rack; module rises slowly on the line

phases.name: traverse
phases.visible: Crane swings the load over the frame; red end-lamps on; everything else on site holds clear

phases.name: set
phases.visible: Module lowers into the slot; three weld stars stitch the corners; the frame is visibly one piece bigger

phases.name: release
phases.visible: Hook returns empty; site floods sweep to the NEXT slot - the world announcing its plan

events.completion: Frame grows by one persistent module; inventory ticks down

interruptions.outcome: Module drops as a heavy pickup; site pauses one window - visible setback

playerInterference: Steal the STAGED module before the pick
Bump the hanging load (it swings - and the site remembers you)
events.criminalOpportunity: Staged modules are the site's cash sitting in the open between deliveries
events.aftermath: PERSISTENT frame growth across the session - the region's clearest proof that time passes
events.fallback: Rig actor lost: staged modules remain; the frame simply stops growing - an abandoned site is its own story

events.title: Work drones assemble a section
events.arrangement: Six drones shuttle between the rack and the frame in overlapping loops, each carrying a strut
events.visibleCue: A cloud of small movers around the frame where yesterday there was one crane

phases.name: launch
phases.visible: Drones deploy from the rig in sequence

phases.name: weave
phases.visible: Continuous carry loops; weld stars ripple along the new section

phases.name: recover
phases.visible: Drones dock back aboard; the section is visibly skinned

events.completion: A frame section gains its skin in one sitting

interruptions.outcome: Others continue; the loop visibly thins

playerInterference: Fly through the weave (they part around you)
events.criminalOpportunity: Downed drones are salvageable tech pickups
events.fallback: Rig lost: drones freeze in place then despawn
events.blockedOn: future.droneSwarm - no small-agent flocking/carry system exists; the traffic stepper is per-ship and too heavy for six shuttling drones

events.title: New structure powers up for the first time
environment: completed structure (frame that reached its final module)
events.arrangement: Workers stand off in a loose arc facing the dark structure - an audience shape
events.visibleCue: Everything near the site STOPS and faces the same way - the world holding its breath is visible at any range

phases.name: stand_off
phases.visible: Work lights die one by one; the site goes fully dark on purpose

phases.name: first_light
phases.visible: The structure's own lamps come up section by section - nav strobes last, like a signature

phases.name: salute
phases.visible: Every hull in the arc flashes its floods ONCE, together - the belt's applause

phases.name: disperse
phases.visible: The audience breaks up to ordinary business; the structure starts its idle loop (strobes, windows)

events.completion: The region has a new permanent lit landmark - and the player watched it be born

interruptions.outcome: Lamps flicker and die; the arc holds a beat of visible disappointment; retry next window

playerInterference: Join the arc and flash your floods with them (the game credits proximity)
Attack during the dark minute - the one moment a finished structure is blind
events.criminalOpportunity: The stand-off minute is the only unlit, unwatched gap the structure will ever have
events.aftermath: Structure joins the sector's persistent lit set; its idle lamps run thereafter
events.fallback: No audience hulls available: first_light still fires alone - quieter, still a birth

events.title: Defense platform test firing
events.arrangement: Range axis marked by two strobes; traffic held clear by the patrol; platform fires down the marked line
events.visibleCue: Two strobes appearing in an empty line, and a patrol shepherding everyone off it

phases.name: range_clear
phases.visible: Patrol sweeps the line; strobes mark it

phases.name: proof
phases.visible: Three timed shots down the lane into the target; flash, spall, silence between

phases.name: safe
phases.visible: Strobes collected; the platform's status lamps settle to armed-idle

events.completion: The region now visibly has teeth; pirates weight away from the pocket

interruptions.outcome: Hold fire; patrol escorts it off; test resumes

playerInterference: Cross the range (the whole event pauses for you - power)
events.criminalOpportunity: The armed-idle lamp pattern is now knowable - and so is its blind arc
events.aftermath: Sector pirate weight drops near the platform (persistent)
events.fallback: Patrol lost: test scrubs to next window
events.blockedOn: future.structureWeapons - structures cannot fire; weapons exist only on ships

events.title: Temporary construction lights come on
events.arrangement: Four masts at the site corners light in sequence, turning the frame into the pocket's brightest object
events.startConditions: Site enters a work window (economy tick)
events.visibleCue: A dark corner of the pocket becoming a lit yard in four steps - shift change made architectural

phases.name: masts_up
phases.visible: Corner floods light one at a time, each with a warm-up flicker

phases.name: work_under_light
phases.visible: Weld stars and crane moves under the floods (composes with ev_frame_module_hoist)

phases.name: masts_down
phases.visible: Reverse sequence at window end; the site keeps only its safety strobes

events.completion: The site's work window is legible from across the pocket by light alone

interruptions.outcome: Three-mast shifts thereafter - a permanent visible scar of the vandalism

playerInterference: Use the lit yard as a navigation landmark
events.criminalOpportunity: Lights-out moments bracket the shift: the yard's valuables are darkest right after masts_down
events.fallback: No rig actor: masts cycle on schedule anyway (they are site fixtures, not crew)

events.title: Surveyor marks out the next build volume
environment: planned site (empty volume adjacent to a station or frame)
events.arrangement: Surveyor flies the eight edges of a box, dropping corner markers - literally drawing the future building in space
events.visibleCue: A surveyor flying PERFECT right angles - nothing natural or lazy flies a wireframe box

phases.name: baseline
phases.visible: First edge flown slowly, pin crabbed, two corners dropped

phases.name: box_out
phases.visible: Remaining edges and corners; the volume becomes visible as four lit points

phases.name: certify
phases.visible: One diagonal pass through the box's heart, then the corners pulse in sequence - signed off

events.completion: Four persistent markers outline where the next frame will rise - the future, staked

interruptions.outcome: One re-drop; twice and the survey rebooks next window

playerInterference: Read the region's future from the marked volumes
Steal markers (petty vandalism with consequences when the frame arrives anyway)
events.criminalOpportunity: A marked volume near a station announces years of future traffic - land speculation, belt style
events.aftermath: Markers persist; a later session's frame event can seed inside them (long-arc chaining)
events.fallback: Surveyor lost mid-box: partial markers persist - an unfinished plan, readable as one
